<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Classify the specified global variable into a set of target independent categories embodied in <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/sectionkind">SectionKind</a>.</p>


<p>getKindForGlobal - This is a top-level target-independent classifier for a global object.</p>


<p>Given a global variable and information from the TM, this function classifies the global in a target independent manner. This function may be overridden by the target implementation.</p>
